verdict: Not yet. NEAR stablecoins mostly move like a trading venue, not a payments network.
vsub: 2 of 6 tests pass. 93% of USDC/USDT transfers on NEAR go through a DEX, and wallet-to-wallet transfers are only 2.3% of transfers. Failed: small tickets, wallet-to-wallet use, broad-based value, steady flow.
T1: 93% of transfers and 24% of volume involve a DEX. Wallet-to-wallet is 2% of transfers but only 10.0% of the dollars.
T2: Volume is estimated at $56.4M a day on average (95% CI $18.8M to $125.8M). Counted by transfers, DEX flow (red) is most of every week. Switch to Volume to see how a single large transfer can dominate a week.
T3: Wallet-to-wallet transfers have a median of $49.98, and 59% are under $100. That is what consumer payments look like. 3% of DEX legs are $1K or more.
T4: 30% of wallet-to-wallet transfers are whole-dollar amounts, against 4.5% for DEX legs. Humans paying humans leave a different fingerprint than bots.
T5: Spearman correlation with NEAR's absolute daily return: all volume 0.26, DEX volume 0.28, wallet-to-wallet volume -0.01. With price level: wallet-to-wallet count 0.22.
T6: Stablecoins on NEAR went from $126.2M to $131.2M over the window while NEAR moved from $1.64 to $3.59. Each dollar turns over about 50.2% a day.
T7: The top counterparty, 4a432082cc1cd551b14d6f075e9345087d64f57c2660400ef33cac5a0bb263b0, is on one side of 59% of sampled volume. The largest 1% of transfers carry 80% of all dollars.
T8: About $55.4M a day of stablecoins enters Intents and $54.5M leaves, against $43.0M of swap flow. Most stablecoin activity at NEAR's edge is cross-chain movement, not native-token trading. Cross-check: DefiLlama puts all NEAR Intents volume (every asset) at $136.0M a day over the same days.
T9: 50% of the sampled stablecoin flow is eth dollars. NEAR is settling other chains' stablecoins, which is a different role from issuing its own.
T10: An estimated 4,163 stablecoin peer transfers a day happen inside Intents (median $10.12, 70% under $100). Small, but this is the payment-shaped flow to watch.
SENS: Robustness check (not a test): one sampled transfer, $2.5M to nfendowment02.near, is 59% of all sampled dollars. Without it, DEX + Intents + lending carry 72% of volume and wallet-to-wallet 25%. Volume shares in a block sample are fragile; transfer counts are not.
changelist:
• Wallet-to-wallet share of volume rises from 10.0% to above 25% for a full quarter.
  • DEX + Intents + lending share of volume falls below 50% even with the single largest transfer set aside (now 30% overall, 72% without it).
  • Daily stablecoin volume stops tracking NEAR volatility (|rho| below 0.3; now 0.26).
  • Round-dollar transfers (invoices, payroll) grow as a share of all transfers (now 5.5%).
impl: Do not underwrite NEAR as a payments network today. The data shows a trading venue with a small but real payments layer: $5.6M a day of wallet-to-wallet stablecoin flow with consumer-sized tickets, sitting on a growing stablecoin base ($131.2M). The long-term bet is optionality: if that layer's share of volume grows, the thesis flips. This dashboard is the tripwire, and anyone can re-run it.
